item.title: An open letter to Dario: if you mean it, open the weights
item.description:
📝 As you know, funding for frontier model development depends on valuations that assume the weights remain proprietary. Every regulation you’ve asked for ends in capture There’s no slowing down frontier models by regulation that wouldn’t lead to regulatory capture. If you really want to slow down frontier AI, call for a law that makes every publicly available model open weights.
🔗 Read more: https://jacob.gold/posts/open-letter-to-dario-amodei-about-open-weights/

item.title: Microcode in Intel's 8087 floating-point chip: the scale instruction
item.description:
📝 Microcode in Intel's 8087 floating-point chip: the scale instruction In the 1970s, floating-point arithmetic was a mess. Each register holds an 80-bit floating-point number. A "normal" floating-point value is tagged as valid.
🔗 Read more: https://www.righto.com/2026/09/8087-microcode-reverse-engineering-fscale.html

item.title: I made a build visualizer to understand Bun's compile times
item.description:
📝 You run it by putting buildprof -- in front of any build command you already use:buildprof -- make -j16 buildprof -- cargo build buildprof -- ninja -C out/target buildprof -- just build buildprof --. Cargo sees crates, Ninja sees build edges and CMake generates instructions for another build system. This even works across build systems.
🔗 Read more: https://lalitm.com/post/buildprof/

item.title: How Trail of Bits helps verify the integrity of Signal chats
item.description:
📝 Signal recently launched an alternative: Automatic Key Verification, a feature that helps validate that your chats are secure without requiring direct safety number comparison. When Automatic Key Verification is turned on, the Signal client periodically fetches Merkle tree heads from the Signal key transparency server. If automatic verification fails, users should fall back on safety number comparison.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.trailofbits.com/2026/08/11/how-trail-of-bits-helps-verify-the-integrity-of-your-signal-chats/
